description: This file contains CSS styles for various speech bubble designs including different triangle shapes, borders, icons, and patterns used for speech and thought bubbles in web UI. It includes styling definitions for classes representing different bubble styles such as isosceles triangles, right-angled triangles, obtuse triangles, bordered bubbles, and decorative icons.

classes.name: .triangle-isosceles
classes.description: Defines a speech bubble with an isosceles triangle pointer, including variants for top, left, and right positioning.

classes.name: .triangle-right
classes.description: Defines a speech bubble with a right-angled triangle pointer, including variants for different orientations.

classes.name: .triangle-obtuse
classes.description: Defines a speech bubble with an obtuse triangle shape pointing in various directions.

classes.name: .triangle-border
classes.description: Defines a speech bubble with a border and triangle pointer, supporting position variants.

classes.name: .example-commentheading
classes.description: Style for speech bubble icon with a rectangular shape and a triangle pointer, functioning as a comment heading.

classes.name: .example-right
classes.description: A styled blockquote with a right-angled triangle tail, used for blockquote elements.

classes.name: .example-obtuse
classes.description: A styled blockquote with an obtuse triangle tail, used for blockquote elements.

classes.name: .example-twitter
classes.description: Style for a speech bubble mimicking Twitter-style message box with a small icon and tail.

classes.name: .example-number
classes.description: A circular numbered bubble with decorative triangles pointing downwards.

classes.name: .pinched
classes.description: A speech bubble with a 'pinched' point, using pseudo-elements for decorative points.

classes.name: .oval-speech
classes.description: An oval-shaped speech bubble with curved edges and a curved tail.

classes.name: .oval-thought
classes.description: A thought bubble with multiple circles connected to the main oval, simulating thinking.

classes.name: .oval-quotes
classes.description: A quotation-style speech bubble with quotation marks and decorative curves.

classes.name: .rectangle-speech-border
classes.description: A rectangular speech bubble with rounded corners and decorative border elements.

classes.name: .oval-speech-border
classes.description: An oval-shaped bubble with border and tail decorations, supporting variations.

classes.name: .oval-thought-border
classes.description: A thought bubble with border and multiple circles, styled with rounded corners.
